article.story: Delaware (5-5) at New Mexico State (3-7), Nov. 21 at 3 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Delaware by 3.5. Against the spread: Delaware 6-4, New Mexico State 4-6. How to watch: ESPN+ Key stats Delaware Offense Overall: 399.4 yards per game (50th in FBS) Passing: 292.8 yards per game (12th) Rushing: 106.6 yards per game (127th) Scoring: 29.7 points per game (54th) Delaware Defense Overall: 411.2 yards per game (120th in FBS) Passing: 275.9 yards per game (134th) Rushing: 135.3 yards per game (54th) Scoring: 27.8 points per game (98th) New Mexico State Offense Overall: 348.2 yards per game (98th in FBS) Passing: 193.2 yards per game (101st) Rushing: 155 yards per game (66th) Scoring: 20.7 points per game (118th) New Mexico State Defense Overall: 345.2 yards per game (54th in FBS) Passing: 211.2 yards per game (67th) Rushing: 134 yards per game (53rd) Scoring: 25.9 points per game (83rd) New Mexico State is 132nd in the FBS with a -9 turnover margin, compared to Delaware's 26th-ranked +5 margin. New Mexico State is 123rd in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 75% of trips. Delaware's red zone defense ranks 30th at 78.6%. New Mexico State ranks 120th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:52. Team leaders Delaware Passing: Nick Minicucci, 2,115 yards, 18 TDs, 4 INTs, 68.1 completion percentage Rushing: Jo'Nathan Silver, 441 yards on 98 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Sean Wilson, 717 yards on 54 catches, 5 TDs New Mexico State Passing: Trey Hedden, 1,272 yards, 9 TDs, 10 INTs, 52.5 completion percentage Rushing: James Jones, 1,090 yards on 179 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: A.J. Williams III, 447 yards on 28 catches, 5 TDs Last game Delaware won 24-16 over Florida International on Nov. 14. Minicucci led Delaware with 230 yards on 27-of-30 passing (90.0%) for two touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball six times for 69 yards and one rushing touchdown. Silver had 22 rushing yards on four carries, adding two receptions for 19 yards. Wilson had eight receptions for 78 yards. New Mexico State lost 27-21 to Missouri State on Nov. 14. Hedden led New Mexico State with 110 yards on 11-of-28 passing (39.3%) for two touchdowns and two interceptions. Jones carried the ball 25 times for 150 yards and scored one touchdown, adding one reception for six yards. Williams put up 38 yards on three catches. Next game Delaware hosts Jacksonville State on Nov. 28. New Mexico State plays at Middle Tennessee on Nov. 28.
